2610.13395.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
2610.13395.paper_summary: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.
2610.13395.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理越來越多地被用來從頭開始構建程序，正如軟體工程師所做的那樣，而不是解決存儲庫中的問題或從給定的需求文檔生成存儲庫。然而，強迫代理發現所需內容並決定系統應如何設計的可擴展可驗證訓練環境仍然稀缺。此外，現有的代理工作流程也無法支持長期開發，其中代理在實施之前探索參考程序。為了解決這些挑戰，我們介紹了ProgramGym，這是一個由Program-Env和Program-Agent組成的框架，旨在為長期程序再現代理提供可擴展的訓練環境。具體而言，Program-Env通過一個反饋驅動的循環從存儲庫構建可驗證的訓練環境，該循環修復運行時沙盒構建和黑箱測試的質量。使用這個新穎的管道，我們獲得了1,648個涵蓋C、C++、Go和Rust的訓練環境。Program-Agent結合了分析、實施和審查的角色隔離工作流程，並進行編譯檢查和故障恢復的修訂管理。在ProgramBench上的實驗顯示，Program-Env和Program-Agent都提高了程序再現的性能。在這些構建的環境上對軌跡進行微調，將Qwen3.8-27B的性能從34.87%提高到42.84%。Program-Agent進一步將基礎模型和SFT模型提高到55.71%和56.25%，均超過一些旗艦模型。我們將釋放ProgramGym，以支持進一步研究從頭開始構建程序的編碼代理。
